value.rationale: The n=6 one-sided five-percent Wilcoxon cutoff has classical exact size 3/64. The complete conditional-pairwise dependence range [0,1/6] and realization by pairwise-independent symmetric continuous observations quantify attainable null-calibration failure by a factor 32/9. This identifies a motivated exact finite testing boundary and the necessity of more than pairwise independence; it is not an arbitrary parameter experiment.
